title: Diagnostic Value of Chest Ultrasound in Pediatrics Lung Diseases
brief_summary: To evaluate the accuracy of chest ultrasound for diagnosis of different lung lesions in comparison to the gold standard among children.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age more than twenty eight day up to 18 yrs .

  * Patients admitted in ER \&chest wards ,with history of fever cough and dyspnea .
  * Chest X ray opacity on recent admission .
  * Patients who developed acute chest infection on top of chronic respiratory disease .

Exclusion Criteria:

* • Neonate .

  * Chronic disease as cardiac disease
study_population: The pediatric patients admitted in ER \&chest wards in Assiut University Children Hospital .
